text:
🇲🇽🏭 <u>AGUASCALIENTES Q1 FDI HITS $342 MILLION — 211% JUMP, BEST FIRST QUARTER IN 9 YEARS</u>

Aguascalientes closed Q1 2026 with $342.1 million in foreign direct investment — a 211.4% leap vs Q1 2025, the strongest first quarter in nine years, per Federal Economía data reported by El Financiero. Japan led the inflows with $144M, Germany $96.3M, US trailing at $66.6M. Manufacturing captured $271.8M of the total — up 127% YoY — and nearshoring keeps flowing into 39 of 57 related sectors.

Mexico picks its partners now, and the empire isn't first in line.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>IRREGULAR MIGRATION THROUGH MEXICO COLLAPSES 87% — AND HALF OF MIGRANTS NOW WANT TO STAY</u>

Irregular crossings into Mexico dropped from 1.2 million in 2024 to 155,730 in 2025 — an 87% collapse, per the UN's International Organization for Migration. Meanwhile 160,192 Mexicans were repatriated last year by Trump's deportation machine. The deeper number buried in the report: over 50% of migrants now want to settle in Mexico permanently — 73% of them without papers.

Mexico isn't the corridor anymore. It's the destination.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>SHEINBAUM BACKS PETRO ON COLOMBIA VOTE-FRAUD PROBE — "GET TO THE BOTTOM OF A POSSIBLE FRAUD"</u>

After far-right Abelardo de la Espriella won Colombia's round one with 43.74% vs leftist Iván Cepeda's 40.90%, President Petro flagged discrepancies between paper records and electoral software counts. Sheinbaum stood with him: "Respeto por las decisiones del pueblo, pero es importante que se llegue hasta lo último sobre un posible fraude." She also called out PRI's Alejandro Moreno for parading there as an "electoral observer."

Runoff June 21. Latin America's left is watching.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>PRI-LINKED FIRM CHARGED IMSS BIENESTAR 200% MARKUP ON DIALYSIS — TIES TO MADRAZO & LATINUS</u>

Zdenko SA — linked to ex-PRI Tabasco governor Roberto Madrazo's family — billed IMSS Bienestar 2,200 pesos per hemodialysis session in Puebla while competitors charged 800. A 100-million-peso 2025 contract was renewed in 2026 despite the gouge. Mexico's UIF has flagged Zdenko since 2023 for suspicious transfers to LatinUs portal and BCG Limited Consulting. Sister firm BITA pocketed another 125 million, then abandoned 971 renal patients in February.

Same playbook, new branding.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>BONAFONT, NESTLÉ & DR PEPPER DRAIN MEXICAN VOLCANIC SPRINGS FOR 25 YEARS — PUEBLA TOWNS STUCK AT 50%+ POVERTY</u>

Three transnationals — France's Bonafont (Danone), Switzerland's Nestlé Waters, US-owned Keurig Dr Pepper — have pumped Mexican volcano aquifers for 20+ years, billions of pesos in annual profits. Bonafont alone has irregularly extracted 1.4 million liters daily from Iztaccíhuatl for 25 years, per its own workers. The hosting towns — Santa Rita Tlahuapan, Juan C Bonilla, Tehuacán — sit at 50%+ poverty per INEGI 2020.

They sold the water back to Mexicans as "development."

🇲🇽💰 <u>4T BIENESTAR REACHES 42.86 MILLION MEXICANS — 1 TRILLION PESOS IN DIRECT TRANSFERS</u>

Welfare Programs hit a historic 42,860,296 beneficiaries in 2026 — over 1 trillion pesos in direct social investment, per Welfare Secretary Leticia Ramírez. 14.1 million elderly pensions, 3 million women aged 60-64, 2 million people with disabilities, 1.8 million farmers under Producción para el Bienestar. As of May 31, 490 billion pesos already disbursed.

"Por el bien de todos, primero los pobres" isn't a slogan — it's a budget line.

🇲🇽💵 43 PRIVATE-SECTOR ECONOMISTS CUT MEXICO 2026 GDP FORECAST TO 1.09% IN BANXICO POLL — SAME WEEK FDI BROKE A RECORD

Banxico’s monthly specialists survey: 2026 GDP expectation slashed from 1.39% to 1.09%, 2027 down to 1.78%, headline inflation 4.35%, core 4.22% — both above the 3% target. Same window, reinvested foreign profits hit $22.2 billion and Q1 FDI broke the all-time record at $23.591B. The split says what the data always says: domestic demand soft, foreign capital still buying. The growth model is rotating, not collapsing.

🇵🇸🗽 ZOHRAN MAMDANI BECOMES FIRST NYC MAYOR SINCE 1964 TO SKIP THE ISRAEL DAY PARADE

Sixty years of mayoral tradition broken in one decision. “I said on the campaign trail I wouldn’t be attending the parade, and I’ve made my views on the Israeli government abundantly clear,” said Mamdani, who has publicly called the war on Gaza a genocide. His administration still secured the route on Fifth Avenue; the mayor just didn’t march. Decades of forced US municipal genuflection cracked in front of cameras.

🔥🇲🇽 PROFECO LAUNCHES PROCEEDINGS AGAINST STUBHUB AND VIAGOGO — RESELLERS LISTED MUNDIAL TICKETS BEFORE FIFA OPENED SALES

Federal consumer protection agency opens infringement proceedings against the two scalper platforms for violating Article 24 of the Ley Federal de Protección al Consumidor — selling tickets before official preventas opened, the textbook definition of “venta especulativa.” Fines could run “varios millones de pesos” and Profeco is studying a criminal complaint. While FIFA prints money, the Mexican state is the only one telling the scalpers to back off.

🇲🇽🏭 EBRARD: MEXICO MUST STOP BEING JUST AN EXPORT MAQUILA — IMPI HIRES 500, AIMS FOR 45% MORE PATENTS BY 2030

The Foreign Ministry’s tech plan: hire 500 new professionals at the Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Industrial, cut patent resolution times, target a 9% increase in industrial property registrations and 45% growth in patents granted to Mexicans by 2030. Ebrard’s frame: “Mexico must move from being an export manufacturing platform to a knowledge and innovation economy” — IP-led sovereignty in the AI era, written into Mexico’s T-MEC strategy.
